PRIVACY

Your inputs stay with you.

Updated October 5, 2026

The PadLab tester reads controller inputs locally. Its application code does not send your controller ID, button activity, axis values or test results to a server.

Session data

Controller readings, observed buttons and drift samples are held in page memory. Reset clears the current button coverage and drift results; ongoing inputs can immediately add new observations. Reloading or closing the page discards the session. Switching controllers starts a fresh session.

Downloads

Export results creates a JSON file in your browser. The file includes the browser-reported controller ID, input snapshot, test measurements and export time. You control whether to share that file.

Cookies and hosting

The tester’s application code sets no cookies, uses no local storage, and includes no analytics or advertising scripts. The hosting platform may process ordinary request logs or use authentication cookies for a private preview. Those platform functions are separate from local controller testing.

External links

Guides link to technical documentation. Visiting those sites is subject to their own policies.
